extracted.intended_audience: aspiring and active Wattpad writers / Wattpad creators looking to improve storytelling and grow audience
extracted.subtask_description: A hub of practical writing guidance and platform-specific advice for authors publishing serialized fiction on Wattpad. Covers story craft (hooks, GMCS, characters, scenes), sentence-level writing, inclusivity, publication steps, and audience-building tips.

rubrics_metrics.name: Goals, Motivation, Conflict, and Stakes (GMCS)
rubrics_metrics.description: The four essential elements: Goals, Motivation, Conflict, and Stakes (GMCS).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Described as central to keeping readers hooked from the first page; resources emphasize using GMCS to drive character choices, scene purpose, and plot momentum.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mastering the 'hook' (first-line hook)
rubrics_metrics.description: Craft an irresistible hook to captivate your audience from the very first line.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance (video and articles) focuses on opening lines and early pages that create immediate curiosity or tension; examples and expert discussion are provided (e.g., Story School episode).

rubrics_metrics.name: Story and scene structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Principles and methods for structuring whole stories and individual scenes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources cover how to build story arcs, structure scenes to advance plot and character, manage pacing, and ensure each scene has purpose and consequence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Character (using GMCS)
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing characters through clear goals, motivations, conflicts, and stakes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes tying character decisions to GMCS so characters feel driven and consequential; includes tips for characterization that supports plot and reader investment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Planning a story
rubrics_metrics.description: Techniques for plotting, outlining, and planning serialized or standalone stories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advice ranges from light planning to more elaborate outlines to organize beats, arcs, and chapter-to-chapter progression appropriate for Wattpad serialization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Serialized storytelling
rubrics_metrics.description: Crafting stories specifically for serialization on a platform like Wattpad.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focuses on episodic structure, chapter-level hooks/cliffhangers, pacing across installments, and strategies to retain readers between releases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sentence-level writing
rubrics_metrics.description: Improving sentence craft, clarity, and readability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Materials address line-level techniques—word choice, rhythm, grammar, and micro-editing—to make prose more engaging and polished for online readers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Setting and worldbuilding
rubrics_metrics.description: Creating believable settings and layered worldbuilding that support story and character.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes tips for grounding readers quickly, using sensory detail, and integrating world details that serve plot and theme without overwhelming the reader.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wattpad tropes and genres
rubrics_metrics.description: Understanding popular tropes and genre expectations on Wattpad.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources encourage writers to learn genre conventions and tropes to meet reader expectations or deliberately subvert them; useful for discoverability and audience targeting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Writing diversity: tips for inclusive stories
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for writing diverse and inclusive characters and narratives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offers tips to represent identities respectfully, avoid stereotypes, and approach sensitive subjects thoughtfully; aimed at making stories inclusive and authentic.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to publish your first story (publishability & discoverability)
rubrics_metrics.description: Steps to publish on Wattpad and options to make your story understandable and discoverable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers practical publishing steps on the platform and metadata/formatting choices (titles, descriptions, tags, covers) that help readers find and understand a story.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opportunities and marketing tips (grow your audience)
rubrics_metrics.description: Strategies and opportunities to expand readership and promote stories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes advice on contests, brand opportunities, community programs, and marketing tactics to increase visibility and audience engagement on Wattpad.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community guidelines and safety
rubrics_metrics.description: Adhering to community guidelines and ensuring reader/writer safety on the platform.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlights the importance of following platform rules and safety policies; resources likely include what content is allowed, moderation practices, and safety best practices for creators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resource Library / Story School (use of curated learning tools)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use Wattpad's Resource Library and Story School videos/articles to learn craft and platform best practices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The hub directs writers to curated tools and lessons (videos, articles, expert interviews) as practical, example-driven instruction for various aspects of writing and publishing on Wattpad.
